data.description: One logical project store selected through the shared Rust storage core. The current SQLite database remains the compatibility backend; the ordered roadmap adds Git-mergeable text and shared server SQL. Preserve all domain data, project identity, links, drafts/history, atomic resource guards, design content tokens and durable operation receipts. Configuration and contract are specified in docs/project-storage.md; task 13 introduces the foundation, task 14 completes extraction, later tasks implement other backends.
data.name: Project Data Store
data.technology: Shared storage adapter; SQLite current, text and server SQL planned
